answer: Require each identity to submit a verifiable delay function output every epoch, seeded by a fresh beacon value nobody can whisper to insiders early. A VDF is inherently sequential, so no hardware farm can forge many proofs in parallel from one fast core; every extra fake identity needs its own dedicated machine running the whole window. That proof is the bridge between cheap keys and costly presence, so sybil cost grows linearly with headcount while honest agents pay one core-epoch.
